decision: Use normal-light image matching for every rated scene; classify shared if maximum correlation >= 0.9, otherwise non-overlapping.
reason: The preceding perfect-agreement gate incorrectly treated low-light matching as ground truth. On known scenes normal-light correlations separated the classes, while low00182 matched normal-light LOL 186.png at approximately 0.9997; the low-light search instead selected adjacent frame 185.png at approximately 0.873. Use image evidence, not model outcomes.
scope: All 290 scenes, including low00182 and low00710.
preprocessing: BGR to grayscale; 48x32 area interpolation; equalizeHist; float64; center and divide by std+1e-9; mean dot product.
model_score_access: No model score files are opened by this script. Commit classification and plan before recomputing subgroup metrics.
prior_gate: Replaced by the normal-light classification protocol based on image evidence; the complete earlier record is retained.
